choose.when:
<set-variable name="upstreamCode" value='@{
                try
                {
                    var code = (string)context.Response.Body.As(preserveContent: true)["error"]?["code"];

                    return new [] { "DeploymentNotFound", "model_not_found", "InvalidRequestError", "BadRequest", "RateLimitReached" }.Contains(code) ? code : "UpstreamError";
                }
                catch
                {
                    return "UpstreamError";
                }
            }' />
            
                routing-error
                
                
                
                
            
            application/json
            @{
                return new JObject(new JProperty("error", new JObject(
                    new JProperty("code", (string)context.Variables["upstreamCode"]),
                    new JProperty("message", "The upstream service rejected the request.")))).ToString();
            }
